description: Source code for the mt9m114 camera driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration, and control functions.

methods.name: mt9m114_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a register value to the device over I2C.

methods.name: mt9m114_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a register value from the device over I2C.

methods.name: mt9m114_write_all
methods.description: Writes multiple register values to initialize the device.

methods.name: mt9m114_set_output_format
methods.description: Configures the output pixel format of the camera.

methods.name: mt9m114_set_fmt
methods.description: Configures the video format and initializes the sensor.

methods.name: mt9m114_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, checks chip ID, and sets default format.
